introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: At LabGo, we are committed to protecting the privacy of your medical and personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your information when you use our healthcare services management platform. LabGo is a healthcare services management application that connects patients with licensed laboratories and certified nurses for laboratory test booking, home sample collection, and secure delivery of test results.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: We collect the following types of information when you use our services:

personalInfo.title: Personal Information
items: Full Name
Email Address
Phone Number
Date of Birth
Gender
Address
Geographic Location

healthData.title: Health & Medical Data
healthData.content: In the course of providing our healthcare services, we collect and process the following health-related data:
items: Laboratory test orders and test types selected
Laboratory test results and medical reports
Prescription images uploaded by the user
Order history related to medical tests
Beneficiary health information (when ordering tests for family members), including name, date of birth, gender, and relationship to the patient

locationData.title: Location Data
locationData.content: We collect your geographic location to:
items: Enable home sample collection by dispatching nurses to your location
Show nearby laboratories in your area
Provide real-time updates during sample collection appointments

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.content: We use your personal and health data for the following purposes:
items: Processing and managing laboratory test orders and bookings
Coordinating home sample collection between patients and certified nurses
Delivering laboratory test results securely through the application
Sending notifications about order status updates, test results, and service communications
Improving the quality and reliability of our healthcare services
Processing payments for services rendered
Complying with applicable healthcare regulations and laws

dataSharing.title: Health Data Sharing
dataSharing.content: Your health data is shared only with the following parties as necessary to provide our services:
items: Partner laboratories — to process your test orders, perform laboratory analyses, and deliver results
Certified nurses — to facilitate home sample collection, including your name, location, and order details
Payment processors — limited financial data for payment processing only (no health data is shared with payment providers)
dataSharing.noSale: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal or health data to third parties for marketing or advertising purposes.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement robust security measures to protect your personal and health information:
items: SSL/TLS encryption for all data transmitted between the application and our servers
Server-side encryption for storing sensitive health and personal data at rest
Role-based access control ensuring only authorized personnel can access your data
Secure authentication with OTP verification and encrypted token storage
Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
Strict access controls separating patient data, nurse data, and laboratory data

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain your data for the following periods:
items: Personal account information — retained as long as your account is active
Laboratory test orders and results — retained for the duration of your account to allow you to access your medical history
Prescription images — retained for the duration of the associated order
Location data — used in real-time for service delivery and not stored permanently
dataRetention.deletion: You may request deletion of your account and all associated data at any time through the application settings. Upon deletion, your personal and health data will be permanently removed from our systems within 30 days.

userRights.title: Your Rights
userRights.content: You have the following rights regarding your personal and health data:
items: Access — view and download your personal and health data at any time
Correction — request correction of any inaccurate personal or health information
Deletion — request permanent deletion of your account and all associated data
Data portability — request a copy of your data in a portable format
Withdraw consent — withdraw your consent for data processing at any time
Complaint — file a complaint regarding data handling practices

medicalDisclaimer.title: Medical Disclaimer
medicalDisclaimer.content: LabGo is a healthcare services management platform that facilitates the booking of laboratory tests and home sample collection. Important disclaimers:
items: LabGo does not provide medical diagnoses, medical advice, or treatment recommendations
LabGo is not a medical device and should not be used as a substitute for professional medical consultation
Laboratory test results delivered through the app are provided by partner laboratories and should be interpreted by a qualified healthcare professional
Always consult your doctor or a qualified healthcare provider for medical advice regarding your test results
In case of a medical emergency, contact your local emergency services immediately

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: For any privacy-related questions, concerns, or requests regarding your personal or health data, please contact us:
